{{- /* The rows of the versions archive (shortcodes/versions-archive.html and its .markdown.md), one dict per version: version, url (its documentation), changelog, apiRef (its API reference page, or nil). A missing changelog falls back to the sdk-ui-all CHANGELOG heading for that release ("## 11.27.0" -> #11270): the version bump job writes no changelog key. The API reference is only the one this theme builds (/api-reference/), and only when that section exists in the current build; the retired external gooddata-ui-apidocs site is never linked, even if a stale apiReference key is set. Expects: the shortcode context. Returns a slice of dicts, empty when no versions are set. */ -}} {{- $rows := slice -}} {{- range partialCached "versions.html" . -}} {{- $changelog := .changelog -}} {{- if and (not $changelog) (findRE `^\d+\.\d+$` .version) -}} {{- $changelog = printf "https://github.com/gooddata/gooddata-ui-sdk/blob/master/libs/sdk-ui-all/CHANGELOG.md#%s0" (replace .version "." "") -}} {{- end -}} {{- $apiRef := "" -}} {{- with .dirpath }}{{ $apiRef = site.GetPage (printf "/%s/api-reference" .) }}{{ end -}} {{- $rows = $rows | append (dict "version" .version "url" .url "changelog" $changelog "apiRef" $apiRef) -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $rows -}}
